test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The median of 9, 11, 15, 17, x, 19, 21 is x, where x is an integer. Which of the following can be the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

Median of 7 number is x

**Formula used:**

Median of odd number = (n + 1) / 2 where, n is number of observation

**Calculation:**

Numbers are

⇒ 9, 11 , 15, 17, x, 19, 21

Total number are = 7

⇒ Median = (7 + 1) / 2 = 8 / 2 = 4th term

So median will be 4th term

On rearranging the terms, we get

⇒ Series = 9, 11, 15, x, 17, 19, 21

As we arrange it in ascending order

⇒ 15 < x < 17

So, only possible value of x is 16

**⇒ Hence, The value of x will be 16**
